response.sql: WITH timing_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing') as timing, AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(eventannotm, 'Missing')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL), above_average_timings AS (SELECT ts.avg_ownership, oa.overall_avg FROM timing_stats ts CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ts.avg_ownership > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) as mean_of_above_average_timings, AVG(avg_ownership - overall_avg) as how_far_above_average_on_average FROM above_average_timings
